notes: Civilization-fitted armor: every soldier's metal/trim and a fitted breastplate now change per era (hide -> bronze scale -> iron/steel plate -> classical muscle -> mail -> plate -> gunpowder/industrial coat) across sword/spear/bow/gun. Reactive forts + gun combat: wall archers animate (breathe/nock-draw-release/recoil/helmet), attackers scale the fort face, parapet swordsmen hack down at them; gun era now aims, muzzle-flashes, recoils, racks the bolt, and holds a low firing-line crouch. Gate now shielded while ANY of your soldiers still hold the field (fixes enemy ranged chipping the castle); commanders/king at waves 10-50 are human leader champions (varied by tier), giants/folklore appear ONLY during the siege after the king dies at wave 50. Layered defense visuals (shield drops at 0 HP, helmet lost when armor gone); last-spear only thrown at a target within half the field; enemy soldiers & enemy castle fire only 1/4 across the field. Formation fix: defenders hold their line (no chasing) and Defend/retreat works; enemy army starts at 50 on wave 1 and grows to 100 by wave 50; hidden QA wave-jump (?debug=1: B/N/K). Fix invisible units/attacks at boss waves: bosses now render via the giant rig only (never the soldier renderer, which aborted the frame and blanked every unit drawn after the boss on both sides). Combat doctrine: a base is shielded while its own soldiers hold the approach lane — walls only take damage once the path is cleared (both gate and enemy castle). Forward orders no longer strand allies at the sealed wall; allies hunt the nearest enemy and hold the line. Siege minions muster forward so the castle can be broken. Folklore Siege era-transition; non-humanoid giants; Stripe go-live config.
